thread:
sara-support: @anna-security incoming from Acme (acct: acme-42). They report getting 403s on KMS decrypts starting ~2026-03-18T13:12:07Z after a key rotation. Attached sample request-id r12345abc and say retries spiked. They want urgent audit logs and confirmation about any egress. Ticket CH-9876.

anna-security: On it. Please paste the exact request-id + timestamps and any error body they saw. Also ask whether they rotated keys from their side or via our infra.

sara-support: Pasted details: request-id=r12345abc ts=2026-03-18T13:12:07Z. Customer saw HTTP 403 from our L7 with body `{"error":"kms_decrypt_forbidden"}`. They said rotation was triggered by their admin at ~13:10 but are unsure. No explicit exfil claims yet, just concern.

security-bot: AutomatedAlert: KMS policy change detected for key alias/acme-42-key at 2026-03-18T13:11:50Z by principal svc-deploy (action=UpdateKeyPolicy). CloudTrail ref: s3://redwood-cloudtrail/prod/2026/03/18/ct-20260318.json

dave-eng: I'll pull runtime logs. @raj-sre can you check netflow for tenant acme-42 13:00-13:30Z? Also verify role bindings on the KMS proxy pods.

raj-sre: Quick netflow query: node dedicated-42-gpu-7 initiated TLS to 52.213.44.77:443 at 2026-03-18T13:12:09Z (conn duration ~4s). That IP isn't in our public partner ranges.

anna-security: 52.213.44.77 not recognized. @dave-eng isolate dedicated-42-gpu-7 immediately and block outbound to that IP. Also pause any ongoing key rotations for that alias.

dave-eng: Taking isolation steps now: `kubectl cordon dedicated-42-gpu-7 && kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --force dedicated-42-gpu-7` then `ssh ops@dedicated-42-gpu-7 'iptables -A OUTPUT -d 52.213.44.77 -j DROP'`. Executed.

tim-oncall: Drafting customer update. Recommend: short, factual. Avoid 'breach' until we confirm. Want to say we quarantined a node, pulled audit logs, and are blocking suspicious egress. :thinking_face:

sara-support: Customer requests an immediate email. Draft suggestion?

anna-security: Suggest: "We are investigating the 403s you reported. We have quarantined one node, pulled relevant audit logs, and are blocking a suspicious external connection. We will provide full findings within 4 hours." Keep it high level. :thumbsup:

security-bot: AuditExport: CloudTrail bundle for acme-42 available at s3://redwood-audit-prod/acme-42/2026-03-18.json. Events show UpdateKeyPolicy by svc-deploy from IP 3.102.11.9 at 2026-03-18T13:11:50Z. Subsequent KMS Decrypt attempts were by runtime-role-acme-42 sts:AssumeRole principal.

raj-sre: Who has permission to act as svc-deploy? Looks like it's tied to our CI pipeline. Checking pipeline run metadata... found run pipeline-runner-5 at 2026-03-18T13:10:05Z.

dave-eng: Looking at deploy artifacts: commit abc123 modified infra/kms/policies/acme-42.json — it added Principal `arn:aws:iam::999999999:user/legacy-admin`. That principal is marked deprecated in our docs.

anna-security: That principal must not be in production policies. Action: rollback policy to previous version, rotate key material if policy allowed external principals, and start incident timeline. Also create a temporary deny rule for that principal.

sara-support: Customer asked whether any customer data left the cluster. They want a SOC bundle. Can we provide redacted logs?

anna-security: Provide logs with request-ids, timestamps, and API actions. Strip payloads and secrets. Legal/compliance should be looped before handing over. @tim-oncall please notify Legal.

tim-oncall: Notifying Legal and Compliance now, also pinging CISO. Setting up bridge if they want to join.

dave-eng: Rolling back policy now: `aws kms put-key-policy --key-id alias/acme-42-key --policy file://policy-prev.json --profile prod` — succeeded.

security-bot: PolicyRollback: key alias/acme-42-key restored to policy version v3 by ops@ci-bot at 2026-03-18T13:25:02Z. No further suspicious egress observed in the following 30m window.

anna-security: Post-incident actions (short): 1) remove legacy-admin principal from infra templates and enforce PR check; 2) require deploy signer verification for CI; 3) add netflow alert for unknown egress from dedicated nodes; 4) deliver SOC bundle to customer with redactions; 5) run key material rotation if external principal had access. I'll create JIRA items.

sara-support: Customer acknowledged and asked to schedule a follow-up call tomorrow. I'll coordinate times.

anna-security: Good work team. Keep notes in the incident timeline and we'll do a short blameless postmortem once we stabilize.
